stories.title: Israel demolishes HQ of U.N. Palestinian refugee agency in East Jerusalem
stories.summary: UNRWA is accusing Israel of breaking international law for demolishing UN buildings in East Jerusalem. Undeterred, Israeli officials say they want to shut down more UNRWA facilities.

stories.title: Winter storm front has entered Texas
stories.summary: A large winter storm is expected to bring widespread heavy snow, sleet, and freezing rain from the Southern Rockies and Plains into the Mid-South beginning Friday.

stories.title: Images show thousands of newly-identified asteroids. And there's more to come
stories.summary: NPR's Ailsa Chang speaks to astronomer Sarah Greenstreet about her team's new discovery of the fastest-spinning large asteroid known to man.

stories.title: West Africa's coastal boom: glitzy cities grow fast, but many are left behind
stories.summary: In the last installment of our correspondent's journey along West Africa's rapidly expanding urban coast, we arrive in Abidjan, Ivory Coast — at the heart of a region where promise and strain collide.

stories.title: In 'Mercy,' an AI justice system determines a detective's fate
stories.summary: In the thriller Mercy, a detective played by Chris Pratt finds himself accused of murder in a justice system entirely run by artificial intelligence. He has 90 minutes to prove his innocence.

stories.title: Chuck Klosterman still sees football as a net positive (but it's close)
stories.summary: NPR's Juana Summers speaks with cultural critic Chuck Klosterman about his new book, which trains a critical eye on the cultural significance and future of a sport he loves: football.
